review_candidates.title: Director, FP&A – Consolidations & Cash Flow
review_candidates.description: McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care. What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you. About The Team The CoverMyMeds (CMM) FP&A organization serves as the central hub for financial planning, performance management, and strategic decision support across the business. The Director, FP&A - Consolidations & Cash Flow will play a critical leadership role in bringing together financial results, forecasts, plans, risks, opportunities, and business insights into a clear, executive-ready financial story that enables informed decision-making and drives business performance. What You'll Do CMM Consolidations Lead the consolidation of financial results, forecasts, annual plans, risks and opportunities, and multi-year outlooks across the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statements. Own and continuously improve planning, forecasting, and reporting processes, ensuring clear timelines, accountability, and execution across FP&A teams. Partner with FP&A leaders to align key assumptions, financial narratives, and recommendations across the organization. Develop and deliver executive-level financial reporting and presentations for the CFO, Finance leadership, business leaders, and Corporate FP&A. Drive automation, standardization, and process improvements that enhance reporting quality, strengthen controls, and increase analytical capacity. Free Cash Flow Leadership Lead Free Cash Flow (FCF), Operating Cash Flow (OCF), and balance sheet planning, forecasting, reporting, and performance analysis. Identify key cash flow drivers, timing impacts, emerging risks, and opportunities for improvement. Collaborate with Accounting, Treasury, Corporate Finance, shared services, and operational leaders to improve cash flow performance and achieve business objectives. Prepare and present variance analyses, forecasts, recommendations, and performance updates to Finance leadership. Team & Cross-Functional Leadership Lead, coach, and develop a team responsible for financial consolidations and cash flow reporting and analysis. Build scalable processes and foster a culture of continuous improvement and talent development. Establish clear priorities, performance expectations, quality standards, and development goals. Influence and coordinate work across FP&A and business teams without direct reporting authority. Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders by translating complex financial information into actionable business insights. Skills You’ll Need Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. 12+ years of progressive experience in Finance, FP&A, Accounting, or a related discipline. 4+ years of people leadership experience, including coaching and developing high-performing teams. Demonstrated experience leading financial consolidations, forecasting, planning, and enterprise performance management processes. Strong knowledge of P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, and financial reporting principles. Expertise in executive-level financial storytelling, reporting, and presentation development. Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and business partnering skills. Ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead through cross-functional collaboration. Strong attention to detail while maintaining a strategic, enterprise-wide perspective. Preferred Skills MBA, CPA, CMA, or other relevant advanced degree or professional certification. Experience within healthcare, healthcare technology, pharmaceutical services, or other complex, matrixed organizations. Columbus Ohio _ Highly Preferred Proven track record improving financial planning and reporting processes through automation and standardization. Experience supporting executive leadership teams and presenting financial insights to senior stakeholders. Advanced knowledge of cash flow management, working capital analysis, and performance improvement initiatives. We are proud to offer a competitive compensation package at McKesson as part of our Total Rewards. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. The pay range shown below is aligned with McKesson's pay philosophy, and pay will always be compliant with any applicable regulations. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered. For more information regarding benefits at McKesson, please click here. Our Base Pay Range for this position $129,400 - $215,600 McKesson has become aware of online recruiting-related scams in which individuals who are not affiliated with or authorized by McKesson are using McKesson’s (or affiliated entities, like CoverMyMeds or RxCrossroads) name in fraudulent emails, job postings or social media messages. Note that McKesson does rely on a virtual assistant (Gia) for certain recruiting-related communications with candidates. McKesson job postings are posted on our career site: careers.mckesson.com. For additional information on McKesson’s full Equal Employment Opportunity policies, visit our Equal Employment Opportunity page. McKesson is committed to being an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and offers opportunities to all job seekers including job seekers with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, please contact us by sending an email to (United States) Disability_Accommodation@McKesson.com or (Canada) Accessibility@mckesson.ca. You will act as a trusted partner to clients and a key internal orchestrator, ensuring the delivery of Mastercard’s full value proposition across products, services, and marketing. The role combines commercial ownership, relationship management, and strategic execution in a fast-moving and highly competitive market. Full ownership of the P&L & the end-to-end relationship with the assigned accounts Responsible for setting sales strategies as it relates to customer accounts that are aligned with western europe strategy and achieving sales goals that drive market share, volume and revenue growth. Partner with customers to deliver customized solutions and comprehensive consulting support Responsible for pipeline management at the account level & to contribute to the achievement of sales and net revenue targets. To assist in designing strategies, messaging, and proposals for customers Collaborates with the account team and customers to plan, execute and monitor progress against annual business plans Assists in local projects and cross-functional initiatives Responsible on the Voice of Customer results Engage with Mastercard cross functional team to design and execute tactical plans to execute the customer strategy and bring relevant business best practices Leverage all Mastercard brand, sponsorship properties, products, and technological payment solution to identify new product opportunities and develop bespoke propositions to maximize segment penetration and exceptional customer value Grow Mastercard share within the assigned accounts Responsible for all administrative and operational issues relate to the assigned accounts Uncover business opportunities and work with MasterCard cross functional team to assess new concepts and ideas of new products that support the market strategy Work closely with the Head of Financial Institutions to recommend and develop market strategy, business planning, expense management, budget, financial monitoring …etc. About You Knowledge of the Luxemburg Financial market and configuration Banking sector market knowledge. Payment Systems market knowledge (experience in issuing and acquiring, fintech) Excellent analytical skills (e.g., cards P&L analysis, financial forecasting, competitive analysis) Superior presentation skills, written and oral (Spanish mother language and English) Proven ability to develop business relationships at all levels, including c-level Results-oriented and customer-focused Strong Sales / Business Development / Relationship Management background. Ability to understand and execute on key operational aspects, and attentive to details Excellent problem solving, analytic capabilities and business acumen Selling Skills with ability to initiate, pursue and close a sale, as well as strong influencing and negotiation skills Bachelor's Degree or equivalent. MBA Preferred. Proven track record of project management capabilities Team-player with hands-on attitude, strong collaborations skills. Can work in autonomy, while being constantly connected to the various stakeholders. Capability to interact with top-management and support functions Humble, flexible, and empathic Having an existing network or connection with the Luxemburg financial sector is a plus. Flexibility to travel in Luxemburg Fluent in English – speaking Luxembourgeois, French and/or German is a key asset. Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

review_candidates.title: Director of Global Manufacturing Execution Systems
review_candidates.description: MES Director - Global Digital Manufacturing Location: Richardson, Texas Full-time, on-site, 25-35% domestic and international travel Our client is a global electronics manufacturer with plants across North America, Europe and Asia, building for aerospace and defense, medical device, and data center customers. They are bringing those factories onto one standard. Right now MES architecture varies site by site, and this role exists to end that. You'll own the global MES strategy and standard architecture across every North American and European site, with the governance frameworks, SOPs and deployment templates that make it stick. The mandate is explicit: replace local customization with scalable, repeatable builds, and hold the line on them. Day to day, you'll direct full-lifecycle MES implementations across a diverse factory footprint on two continents, and drive the convergence of MES with ERP/SAP, PLM and the automation layer of SCADA and PLC. You'll own the manufacturing data architecture that feeds advanced analytics, predictive maintenance and quality tracking. You'll negotiate enterprise contracts and SLAs with the cloud provider, foundation software vendors and systems integrators, and you'll keep every platform inside CGP, ITAR, FDA/ISO 13485 and NIST requirements. You'll lead a geographically dispersed team of MES engineers, project managers and business analysts across time zones, and spend real energy aligning plant managers and executive stakeholders on why the standard is worth adopting. This suits an IT/OT leader with 15+ years in digital factory environments, 7+ leading multi-site, multi-country deployments, and genuine operating experience on both sides of the Atlantic. Multi-million CapEx ownership and travel of 25-35% come with it.

review_candidates.title: Database Automation Engineer - Synsel Techniek
review_candidates.description: Bij een retailorganisatie in Rotterdam ondersteun je het cloudplatform en bouw je het verder uit. Als Database Automation Engineer automatiseer je databasebeheer en infrastructuur met Infrastructure as Code en Python. Je werkt met Oracle-databases op AWS en helpt ontwikkelteams hun applicaties betrouwbaar naar productie te brengen. Daarbij verbind je kennis van databasearchitectuur, deployment pipelines en monitoring aan praktische verbeteringen: van automatische back-ups tot beter presterende SQL-query’s. Je werkt dagelijks samen met developers en infrastructuurcollega’s in een internationaal agile team. De ene keer onderzoek je een backendstoring of configureer je database-auditing, de andere keer bereid je een Aurora-versie-upgrade voor. Je schrijft testbare automatiseringscode en weegt verzoeken van verschillende teams af op urgentie en impact. Via interne trainingen en samenwerking verdiep je je kennis van cloudautomatisering, databaseperformance en betrouwbaar beheer. Wat ga je doen? Je ontwikkelt serverless Python-automatisering voor dagelijkse back-ups naar S3. Je optimaliseert SQL-query’s samen met developers. Je configureert Oracle-auditing en ondersteunt auditors met rapportages. Je onderzoekt backendstoringen met monitoring- en loggingtools. Je helpt ontwikkelteams bij het plannen van Aurora-database-upgrades. Je automatiseert deployment pipelines met Python en schrijft unit tests. Je breidt het cloudplatform uit met Infrastructure as Code en maatwerkautomatisering. Wat vragen we van jou? Je hebt ervaring met cloudplatformen, bij voorkeur AWS; AWS Solutions Architect Associate-certificering is een pre. Je ontwikkelt in Python en automatiseert beheerprocessen van bootstrap tot back-up. Je hebt ervaring met Oracle 19c en Oracle GoldenGate; Oracle Database-certificering is een pre. Je kent query-tuning, de Oracle RDS-architectuur en de aandachtspunten van Oracle op AWS; Aurora-kennis is een pre. Je werkt met monitoring- en loggingtools zoals Datadog en stelt prioriteiten op basis van impact. Je woont momenteel in Nederland en werkt oplossingsgericht samen met verschillende ontwikkelteams. Wat bieden wij jou? Bruto maandsalaris tussen € 3.800 en € 5.000 (indicatie op basis van functie en ervaring) Hybride werken met een ingerichte thuiswerkplek, inclusief laptop en bureaustoel. Reiskostenvergoeding, pensioenregeling en een vergoeding voor je werkplek. Toegang tot meer dan 30 interne trainingen voor je verdere ontwikkeling. Ruimte om eigen ideeën voor databasebeheer en cloudautomatisering uit te werken. Samenwerking met internationale collega’s en gezamenlijke teamactiviteiten. Personeelskorting op het productassortiment. #Jobster

review_candidates.description: BASIS International School Hangzhou is seeking qualified candidates for an AP World History Teacher for the 2027-28 school year! Are you an experienced educator looking to grow your career with an established and high-achieving school network? Apply now for our AP World History Teacher position with BASIS International School Hangzhou. Why Choose BASIS International & Bilingual Schools? BASIS International & Bilingual Schools is a dynamic, rapidly growing network of schools in China known for academic excellence and innovation. Since our first school opened in Shenzhen in 2015, BASIS International & Bilingual Schools has expanded across China, with campuses in Hangzhou, Guangzhou, Nanjing, Chengdu, and Wuhan. In 2024, we proudly launched three new schools in Shenzhen, including our first Early Childhood Education campuses, and opened two new schools in 2026: BASIS Bilingual School Beijing and BASIS Bilingual School Guangzhou. Our students consistently gain admission to prestigious universities worldwide, such as Harvard, Princeton, Oxford, MIT, and Cornell, with nearly 100% of graduates accepted into Top 50 U.S. universities and other similarly rated universities in the UK, Canada, and Hong Kong. About BASIS International School Hangzhou BASIS International School Hangzhou opened in 2018, and was the first BASIS International School in China outside of Guangdong province. The school welcomes students in Grades Pre-K – 12 and celebrated its first graduates in 2022. Our faculty team is made up of teachers and administrators from around the world, bringing diverse perspectives and experiences to our community. We embrace a growth mindset, enhanced by our campus location in Qiangjiang New Town District where modern city development and areas of natural beauty and historical significance meet. Nearby high-speed trains make traveling to other cities, such as Shanghai, easy and convenient. At BASIS, we believe students can achieve authentic learning through robust challenges. From middle school onwards, our students engage in advanced coursework, setting high expectations while establishing a solid foundation in core subjects, revisiting and reinforcing concepts in greater depth each year to prepare for entry into honors and Advanced Placement levels starting in ninth grade. As an AP World History teacher, you build upon this strong foundation, deepening students' understanding of the subject while preparing them for success in AP testing. You Will Also: Foster meaningful relationships with each student to ensure a personalized and successful learning trajectory Guide students in pursuing academic achievement, personal responsibility, and intellect Pursue continuous professional growth by participating in ongoing professional development, collaborating with colleagues, and staying informed on the latest educational techniques and best practices in your field Contribute to a positive and collaborative school community Work Experience Who We’re Looking For Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in your subject area. Experience: At least two years as the lead teacher in a classroom, a requirement for obtaining a working visa. Collaboration: A team player eager to share and learn from colleagues worldwide. High Standards: A commitment to maintaining and enhancing the rigor of international education. Benefits What We Offer At BASIS International & Bilingual Schools, We Believe In Investing In Our Teachers. Our Benefits Package Is Competitive, And We Offer Unparalleled Support To Our Expatriate Staff: Competitive Salary: Reflective of your education and experience. Global Health Coverage: Including coverage in the U.S. for American citizens. Housing: Provided furnished accommodation or a housing allowance. Retirement Benefits: Receive an annual retirement bonus equal to 10% of your annual salary. Travel Benefits: Paid travel to and from China at the start and end of your contract, plus an annual travel allowance. Relocation Support: Moving allowance and comprehensive assistance with visa, work permit and residence permit arrangements. Free School Meals: Say goodbye to meal planning—enjoy delicious, complimentary breakfast and lunch on campus. Full BASIS Tuition Waiver: Enroll up to two school-aged children per teacher, or up to three children per teaching couple, with free tuition. Savings Potential: Maximize your earnings with our comprehensive benefits package, low cost of living, and competitive salary—allowing you to save significantly while living and working in China. Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development, mentorship, and career advancement within our growing global network. Our HR and Operations teams will guide you every step of the way, from visa acquisition to settling into your new home. We’re committed to ensuring a smooth transition so you can focus on what you do best—teaching. Become a Better Educator At BASIS International & Bilingual Schools, we don’t just shape students’ futures, we also invest in yours. Through ongoing professional development and coaching, we help you grow into a more effective educator and leader. Whether your aim is to become a mentor or move into school administration, your time at BASIS can accelerate your career in nearly any direction you choose to go.

review_candidates.title: AI Implementation Strategist
review_candidates.description: AI Digital is an AI-native media consultancy and innovation partner powered by an Open Garden framework. Founded in 2018, AI Digital’s global team of 680+ specialists connects clients to audiences through a unique blend of human expertise and advanced technology, delivering unbiased, AI-enhanced media solutions for brands and agencies. About the team We’re the AI & Automation Engineering team. Our mission is to make life easier for every internal team through automation, from standalone tools to Operational Hub, the unified platform we’re building to house all the automation tools each department needs. We work directly with Growth, Strategy & Planning, Client Service, Operations, and Data & Solutions (among others), so most of what you build is used by the people you work with every day. The team today is small: a Product Manager, a Full-Stack Engineer, and an AI Implementation Engineer. But the company is growing very fast, and so is our team. About the role We’re looking for AI Implementation Engineer who thrives at the intersection of automation, AI-assisted development, and practical tool-building. You’ll work alongside our existing engineers to design, build, and maintain the internal tools and automated workflows that power day-to-day operations across the company. The work is hands-on and fast-moving: you’ll turn business needs into working solutions using n8n, LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI), and AI-assisted development tools like Replit and Claude Code. If you build with AI, want real ownership over features, and want to work closely with the people who use what you build, this is the role for you. Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain n8n workflows that automate internal business processes. Troubleshoot and improve existing automations to keep them reliable, efficient, and easy to maintain. Develop and launch lightweight internal tools using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code and Replit. Integrate systems and services through APIs and webhooks, including LLM APIs such as Claude and OpenAI. Work directly with internal stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into practical solutions. Test tools and workflows, gather user feedback, and deliver improvements as business needs evolve. Contribute new features to the team’s Operational Hub and collaborate with engineers on technical decisions. Take ownership of assigned projects, from requirements gathering through launch and ongoing support. Requirements 2+ years of professional experience in QA (preferred), analytics, or project management. Hands-on programming skills are also welcome. Hands-on experience building, debugging, and maintaining workflows in n8n or Make.com. Ability to build and ship functional applications using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Replit, Cursor, or similar. A working understanding of APIs, webhooks, and data flows, with the ability to troubleshoot integration issues. Basic proficiency in SQL, ideally BigQuery, including reading and working with structured data. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical teams. Ability to understand business processes, clarify requirements, and translate them into practical tools and automations. A proactive approach to problem-solving, willingness to learn, and ownership of your work. Nice to have Experience with Google APIs, particularly Sheets, Drive, and Calendar. Familiarity with Clerk or similar authentication and authorization tools. Knowledge of React or basic frontend development. Experience integrating Slack, Asana, HubSpot, or similar business tools. Experience in AdTech or MarTech. Portfolio If we move forward after the initial HR interview, we’ll ask you to share a portfolio of tools or automations you’ve delivered. Please highlight their measurable business impact and explain your personal contribution to each project. What We Offer: Compensation that values your expertise. Work from anywhere: Fully remote to suit your lifestyle. 31 days of paid time off: 21 days of annual leave + 10 days of sick leave, because your health and work-life balance matter. Private health insurance and FitPass: supporting your well-being both inside and outside of work. Growth-focused environment: Access to learning resources and clear pathways for growth. Fun team events: Virtual cooking classes, yoga sessions, team quizzes and more. A culture of trust: We cut the red tape — results over rules always. Open talk, ownership, and getting things done together. AI Digital does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other protected class in terms of employment. We support workplace diversity and believe strongly that it contributes to a broader collective perspective that consistently leads to better products and a better company. We are working hard to increase the diversity of our team.
